dog.description_text:
Don’t let her small size fool you—Dandelion has a BIG personality! At just 4 years old, this little California girl is full of fun, sass, and endless charm. She came to us from animal control in California and is ready to find a family who will appreciate her larger-than-life personality.
Dandelion is the kind of dog who makes every day more fun. She’s playful, silly, and always ready to be part of the action. If you’re looking for a small dog with a whole lot of personality, Dandelion might just be your girl!
